messages:
tyler-support: :rotating_light: Customer acme-inc reporting sudden p99 jump on /v1/generate after last runtime deploy. p95 ~ 180ms -> 240ms, p99 220ms -> ~980ms. Started ~2026-09-28 02:05 UTC. Affected model: redwood/longform-v2, seq len ~1400.

ana-dev: :eyes: saw a small uptick in canary but not this big. Any idea if the heuristic auto-switched kernels?

ben-runtime: infra-bot flagged a kernel-autoswitch to SDPA for long sequences at 02:03 UTC. I can see heuristic weight for sdpa rose after compile flag landed.

infra-bot: Alert: kernel_autoswitch(reason=compileflag_change) triggered on pool rpool-prod-3 at 02:03:12. Samples: 40 reqs, seq>1024, fallback_rate=7%.

marta-sre: Repro steps requested. Tyler can you paste a curl we can run to reproduce? Also is there any recent instance churn?

tyler-support: quick repro curl I used: ``curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"redwood/longform-v2","input":"<~1400 tokens payload>","max_tokens":64}'``. On our side: 10/10 p99 ~0.9s over last 20 mins. p95 stable.

ana-dev: Looks like SDPA path has worse tail for that model+seq combo. Two mitigation options: 1) force per-pool kernel preference to prefer FlashAttention for longform-v2, 2) revert the compile flag that boosted SDPA priority. I'd vote for targeted kernel preference rollback first.

ben-runtime: I can roll a hotpatch to change kernel_priority for rpool-prod-3. Command: ``redwoodctl kernel set-priority --pool rpool-prod-3 --model redwood/longform-v2 --priority flashattn=100,sdpa=10``. Want me to run now?

marta-sre: Do it. Also pin a temporary routing rule to move acme-inc traffic to rpool-prod-1 which hasn't flipped heuristics. Runbook: if p99 drops <300ms within 5m, keep. If not, revert compile flag.

ben-runtime: Running hotpatch now. Output: ``PATCH applied to rpool-prod-3 (flashattn priority=100). Rolling to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m``

tyler-support: Monitoring metrics... p99 dropped from ~980ms -> 260ms within 90s for acme-inc. :thumbsup:

marta-sre: Nice. Keep watch for 15m. Open follow-up to revert compile flag in dev and add a regression test (seq 1200-1600) in kernel-selection-suite.

ana-dev: Agreed. I'll open PR to add a targeted regression eval and we should also add a fallback hysteresis: avoid switching to SDPA for ongoing requests if p99 delta > 2x.

ben-runtime: Filed a rollback task for the compile flag to canary tomorrow at 03:00 UTC and added an ops-runbook step to make kernel toggles change auditable.

marta-sre: Closing incident if stable for 15m. Postmortem: root cause suspected: compile flag increased SDPA selection score for long sequences, but SDPA tail perf regresses on our current kernel build for longform-v2. Action items: (1) add regression eval (ana), (2) schedule compile-flag bisect and repro (ben), (3) add hysteresis to kernel-autoswitch (prod infra).

tyler-support: Thanks all. I'll notify acme-inc that we've mitigated and follow up with timeline for permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
